items.title: Iran says the U.S. is standing in the way of Hormuz deal amid talks with Oman
items.description: Iran and Oman are approaching a deal to secure safe transit through the Strait of Hormuz and future administration of the vital economic artery.

items.title: Medical device maker Boston Scientific is being hit by a cyberattack. The shares are falling
items.description: The attack has disrupted the company's ability to ship products, and it's not clear when services will be restored.

items.title: Amazon service Bezos once called 'artificial artificial intelligence' is shutting down
items.description: Mechanical Turk launched in 2005 as a way to farm out tasks that are easy for humans to complete but too challenging for computers.

items.title: Hyundai has grown more than any automaker in the U.S. — and it's not done yet
items.description: The South Korean automaker wants to keep going by ramping up production at a new $7.6 billion plant in Georgia to capture more sales and market share.

items.title: Mortgage rates hit highest level in 3 weeks, weakening demand further
items.description: Mortgage rates rose again last week causing demand for both refinances and purchase loans to drop. Rates climbed to their highest level in three weeks.

items.title: Haidilao shares jump as delivery growth and new restaurant brands boost outlook
items.description: Haidilao shares rose after results showed strong growth in delivery and newer restaurant formats, even as revenue from its core hotpot restaurants declined.

items.title: China's short-drama producers flood the market with cheap bets — and let audiences pick the winners
items.description: The short-drama model offers an alternative to traditional entertainment, but rising distribution costs and audience-retention challenges remain.

items.title: Temasek-backed investor behind Unitree pitches Singapore as Chinese robots' path to U.S.
items.description: As Washington shuts out Chinese robotics, a Temasek-backed VC bets that startups with genuine development in the city-state can still reach American buyers.

items.title: 'Too much too quickly': Indonesia's growth ambitions questioned by economists
items.description: Indonesia has set an ambitious growth target, but economists aren't sure it can get there while keeping the deficit in check.

items.title: HP partners with U.S.-blacklisted Huawei for licensing the Chinese company's WiFi tech
items.description: It's a sign of adoption of Huawei technology outside China, despite the U.S. restricting the company from working with American suppliers such as Google.

items.title: Trump's Saudi nuclear deal reaches Congress as experts warn of proliferation risk
items.description: Some Democratic lawmakers and nonproliferation advocates have criticized the pact for not including a permanent prohibition on enrichment or reprocessing.

items.title: From military alliance to economic partnership: How Trump is redefining U.S.-South Korea ties
items.description: Trump last Sunday instructed the Pentagon to cut military drills because they were "costly" and send "inappropriate and hostile" signals to North Korea.

items.title: Sen. Darline Graham, Trump's pick for South Carolina Senate, wins GOP primary
items.description: Sen. Darline Graham on Tuesday defeated Rep. Ralph Norman, winning the GOP nomination for a South Carolina Senate seat.

items.title: Here's why markets are starting to care about the 2026 election 10 weeks out
items.description: Wall Street analysts are tuning in 10 weeks ahead of the Nov. 3 election with concerns about risks to investors depending on how the U.S. results turn out.

items.title: Dick’s Sporting Goods just had its worst day ever. Here's Jim Cramer's advice on the stock now
items.description: CNBC’s Jim Cramer said investors shouldn’t give up on Dick’s after its record 30% plunge.

items.title: Instagram chief Mosseri says in social media addiction trial he doesn't tell team to 'hide anything'
items.description: Instagram chief Adam Mosseri testified during a federal trial that he doesn't direct employees to withhold information that could pose legal risks to Meta.

items.title: SpaceX plans to build a $100 billion spaceport in Louisiana
items.description: SpaceX plans to establish its Starbase, LA in Vermilion Parish, which will "support thousands of launches annually."

items.title: Waymo to launch driverless rides in Germany in 2027, entering third market outside U.S.
items.description: Waymo has been the biggest robotaxi player in the U.S., and has announced plans to enter the U.K., Japan and now Germany.

items.title: Canada unveils retaliatory tariffs on about $20 billion of U.S. goods
items.description: Canadian trade negotiators left the U.S. last week after failing to clinch a trade deal that would stop President Donald Trump's new tariffs from taking effect.

items.title: OpenAI data center chief Chris Malone is out, the latest in a string of executive exits
items.description: An OpenAI spokesperson said the company "recently reorganized our infrastructure organization to support the scale and pace of our work."
